resources.string: ROOTED IN VALUES. OPEN TO POSSIBILITY.
Meaningful connections for people who value culture, family and a lasting commitment.
Connect through shared values and honest intentions.
Make room for the languages, traditions and communities that matter to you.
You choose what to share, and whether to involve someone you trust.
Take your time. Stay in control.

Never send money to someone you have only met online. Keep your address, financial details and identity documents private. When meeting, choose a public place and tell someone you trust.\n\nCalaf is for adults aged 18 and over. Family involvement must always be your choice.
